{{Quote|There you go. And in kidnapping a celebrity with some interplanetary fame, we have ensured that the civilian news will hear about Thaal and that civilian authorities will launch their own investigations. Not to mention the musicians' union. You don't want to mess with the musicians' union.|Trey Courser|<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>}}
The '''Musicians' union ''' was a labor organization representing [[Musician/Legends|musicians]].<ref name="MK" /> In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> members of [[Wraith Squadron]], a [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit, jokingly suggested that the union would become involved after their kidnapping of the famous singer [[Ledina Chott]].<ref name="MK" />
